summary: Five-view high/low/reference comparison and full opposite inspected. Final 14750-triangle model retains the complete lid, seat, tank, rounded ceramic shell and recessed bowl; original high PBR bake restores coherent white/cream ceramic without the canonical black shards. Small edge rounding, minor plinth/lid irregularity and strong underside studio reflection remain. Both failed canonical reductions and separate local reconstruction attempts are retained.
